info.title: Saastic Universal API
info.description: Saastic helps teams collect customer reviews, send review requests by email or SMS, manage locations and customer feedback, and export reviews through the More Good Reviews REST API.

post.description: Creates a customer charge in Saastic.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

email.description: The customer's email address. Required when phone is not provided.

phone.description: The customer's phone number. Required when email is not provided.

amount.description: Amount of charge in the lowest currency denomination.

locationSlug.description: The slug of a location. If provided, the default location for the customer will be changed to this one.

chargedAt.description: The date the customer was charged.
